title: Catalytic quantum thermodynamics beyond additivity and reduced-state monotones
summary: The generalized second laws of quantum thermodynamics are usually formulated in terms of Rényi divergences and the associated family of generalized free energies. In catalytic thermal transformations, this framework typically certifies the existence of a suitable catalyst but does not make the catalytic contribution explicit in the resulting system-level inequalities. Here we develop a complementary formulation based on non-additive divergences, whose pseudo-additive structure yields a family of generalized free energies with an explicit catalyst-dependent correction term.
